
# 1. 패키지 불러오기

설치된 패키지를 불러온다.

```{r packages}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(phyloseq)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(decontamSensitivity)
})
```

# 2. DT phyloseq와 metadata 준비

```{r data}
project_dir <- "D:/KSY/Project/2.DT_Swab[논문작업pf남경화]/Rproj_DT_Swab"

phy <- readRDS(file.path(
  project_dir,
  "Phyloseq/phy_F270R240_260812_v3.rds"
))

metadata <- read.delim(
  file.path(project_dir, "metadata/DT_metadata.tsv"),
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

rownames(metadata) <- metadata$sample_id
metadata <- metadata[sample_names(phy), , drop = FALSE]
metadata$control_status[
  metadata$control_status == "negative-control"
] <- "control"

stopifnot(
  inherits(phy, "phyloseq"),
  identical(sample_names(phy), rownames(metadata)),
  !anyNA(metadata$control_status)
)

sample_data(phy) <- sample_data(metadata)
phy
```

# 3. 전체 QC를 한 번에 실행

OTU table이 `taxa × sample` 또는 `sample × taxa` 중 어느 방향이더라도
패키지가 자동으로 확인하여 처리한다.

```{r run-qc}
qc <- run_decontam_qc(
  ps = phy,
  control_column = "control_status",
  control_label = "control",
  thresholds = seq(0.1, 0.9, by = 0.1),
  selected_threshold = 0.5,
  comparison_threshold_low = 0.4,
  taxonomy = "Genus",
  plot_all_thresholds = TRUE
)

qc
```

# 4. 결과표

```{r tables}
knitr::kable(qc$tables$threshold_summary, digits = 2)
knitr::kable(qc$tables$library_size_summary, digits = 1)
knitr::kable(head(qc$tables$flagged_taxa, 20), digits = 2)

# 기존 kA, odds.sample, odds.control, summarized에 해당하는 표
head(qc$tables$prevalence_enrichment)
```

# 5. 결과 그림

```{r score-and-threshold, fig.height=8}
qc$plots$score_distribution
qc$plots$threshold_sensitivity
```

```{r sample-retention}
qc$plots$sample_retention
```

```{r flagged-genera}
qc$plots$flagged_taxa_reads
```

```{r genus-before-after, fig.width=12, fig.height=7}
qc$plots$taxa_reads_before_after
```

```{r prevalence-enrichment}
qc$plots$prevalence_enrichment
```

# 6. 모든 threshold의 taxa 그림

각 목록의 이름은 `"0.1"`, `"0.2"`, ..., `"0.9"`이다. 특정 그림은
`qc$plots$flagged_taxa_reads_by_threshold[["0.7"]]`처럼 꺼낼 수 있다.

```{r all-flagged-taxa-plots, fig.height=7}
for (threshold_name in names(qc$plots$flagged_taxa_reads_by_threshold)) {
  plot_object <- qc$plots$flagged_taxa_reads_by_threshold[[threshold_name]]
  if (!is.null(plot_object)) print(plot_object)
}
```

```{r all-before-after-plots, fig.width=12, fig.height=7}
for (plot_object in qc$plots$taxa_reads_before_after_by_threshold) {
  print(plot_object)
}
```

# 7. 필터링된 phyloseq 사용

```{r filtered-phyloseq}
phy_decontam <- qc$filtered_phyloseq
phy_decontam
```
